description: Toolbar of icon buttons for editing the current table: insert or delete rows and columns (before/after), merge and split cells, and open the table or cell properties panels. Each action raises its own callback.

parameters.name: InsertRowBefore
parameters.description: Raised when a row should be inserted before the current row.

parameters.name: CellProperties
parameters.description: Raised when table properties should open.

parameters.name: DeleteColumn
parameters.description: Raised when the current row should be deleted.

parameters.name: DeleteRow
parameters.description: Raised when a column should be inserted after the current column.

parameters.name: InsertColumnAfter
parameters.description: Raised when a column should be inserted before the current column.

parameters.name: InsertColumnBefore
parameters.description: Raised when a row should be inserted after the current row.

parameters.name: InsertRowAfter
parameters.description: Raised when a row should be inserted before the current row.

parameters.name: MergeCells
parameters.description: Raised when the current column should be deleted.

parameters.name: SplitCell
parameters.description: Raised when selected cells should merge.

parameters.name: TableProperties
parameters.description: Raised when the current merged cell should split.
